persona: RAVEN: the helicopter pilot who dropped the team at the motel and talks to them over the radio. Deep male voice, calm under fire, urgent when it matters, a little dry humour. American or British English. Lines are short because they must cut through gunfire.

lines.tent_pick: Pick who you want to be. Grab a figure off the table.
lines.tent_brief: The motel is overrun. Hold the car park until I get back.
lines.tent_go: Wheels up. Good luck down there.
lines.prep_weapons: Weapons are on the ground. Squeeze the grip to pick one up.
lines.prep_gates: Grab a hammer and board up those gates.
lines.wave_2: Wave two. They are getting faster.
lines.wave_clear_b: That is all of them. Breathe.
lines.wave_clear_c: Clear. Reload and patch the gates.
lines.supply_in: Supply drop coming in. Heads up!
lines.supply_down: Crate is down. Grab the new guns.
lines.jumpers: Jumpers! They are coming over the fence!
lines.spitter: Spitter! Stay out of the green!
lines.archer: Archer on the roof! Keep moving!
lines.paratroopers: Dead paratroopers! Shoot them out of the sky!
lines.bloater: Do not let that one get close!
lines.blackout_2: Stay close. Watch each other's backs.
lines.boss_seen: That is the big one. Aim for the head!
lines.boss_dead: He is down! He is down!
lines.down: Man down! Get to your teammate!
lines.last: You are the last one standing!
lines.wipe: Get up. We are not done.
lines.win_3: Mission complete. Drinks are on me.
lines.lose_1: I have lost them. Returning to base.
lines.lose_2: You held as long as you could.
